title: VQA-MHUG: A Gaze Dataset to Study Multimodal Neural Attention in Visual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Spearman's rank correlation between human gaze/mouse-tracking maps and a synthetic center fixation map to evaluate the tendency of attention to focus on the center of an image, comparing this spatial bias across different datasets.

Evaluating model accuracy on the VQA-CP (Visual Question Answering under Changing Priors) dataset—which features intentionally dissimilar answer distributions between training and validation splits—as part of a Machine Difficulty Score to penalize models that exploit statistical language priors instead of visual grounding.
